cap_exempt.rule: Series excluded from cap condition 1 only (they are still shown and judged for display): self_observation = HTTP 402 attempts/success in the market chapter (this site returns no 402, so no value can arise; the value depends on this site's own implementation, not on an external primary source); manual_update = sources fixed as manually updated (sources.*.json update_method=manual; the METI transformer capacity index, whose automated fetch has been blocked by AWS WAF since 2026-08-30). Added 2026-10-14 (definition v1.4). Changing this list is a rule change recorded in the decisions ledger.

timezone: JST (UTC+9); region_today is each edition local date used for age
stale_rule: stale = age_days > stale_threshold_days, where the threshold is 2 x the update frequency: daily 2, weekly 14, monthly 62, monthly_lagged 92 (monthly statistics published with a lag of about 6-7 weeks, e.g. Eurostat STS; added 2026-09-04), quarterly 184 (added 2026-09-04), monthly_lag_long 184 (monthly statistics published with a lag of about 5 months, e.g. SingStat monthly electricity generation; added 2026-10-01 for the Singapore edition); annual and irregular series are not judged. Business-day series (v1.3, switched 2026-10-01, decision D-2026-09-25-08): stale = business_days_elapsed > stale_threshold_business_days (2), where business_days_elapsed counts the business days from last_confirmed to region_today - weekends excluded, and Japanese public holidays (Cabinet Office CSV) excluded for Japan edition series; U.S. federal holidays and TARGET closing days are not yet applied (proposal B6, October 2026). This replaces the calendar-day threshold of 4 used until 2026-10-01 (v1.0-v1.2), which flagged jgb_yield as stale across the 2026-09-19..23 holiday run. Definitions: 指標定義_サイト生存状態_health.md. source_review = under_review when the last 3 or more fetch attempts failed in a row (consecutive_fetch_failures; v1.2, 2026-09-05): the series is shown as observing (source under review), its last confirmed value is kept and not judged until the source is confirmed.

cap_condition.rule: Condition 1 for raising this site's caps (series 100 / pages 60 / editions 4; CLAUDE.md, decision D-2026-10-14-01, 2026-10-14): among judged series (every series not listed in cap_exempt), 7 consecutive days with stale 0, last fetch failed 0, source under review 0 and not-yet-measured 0. judged_ok is the value for this generation; the 7-day run is read from the generation history (cap_judged_ok) by the weekly report. This block does not change site_status.

publish.rule: All three editions publish from their daily batch (Japan edition switched from manual to automatic on 2026-09-12; a publish lock file pauses the Japan batch when present). live_age_days = (value date on the locally generated summary.json) - (value date on the live summary.json), judged by the value date and not by the generation time: 2 days = caution, 3 = warning, 5 = action (fixed 2026-09-12). transfer_failures_since_last_success is an independent counter that alerts on the first failure. Skipped days are shown but do not alert. This block does not change site_status.
publish.ledger: Internal publish ledger (not published). One row per transfer (edition; scope; files ok/failed; transfer exit codes), days finished without publishing, and a live observation. Added 2026-09-12.

thresholds.basis: live_age_days = (value date on the local site\ summary.json) - (value date on the live summary.json). Value date, not generation time. Fixed by the owner on 2026-09-12.
thresholds.transfer_failure: any failed or partial transfer since the last successful one raises the alert (independent counter, fires on the first failure)

_note: AI Lifeline - liveness of the whitepaper itself (added 2026-09-03). For every published series in every edition: last confirmed observation date, update frequency, next expected update, stale (past the expected date by more than the threshold), and the status of the last fetch. Regenerated after each edition daily batch; on failure the previous file is kept. Nothing here judges the observed world - only whether this site is keeping up.
